1. A leverage-reducing landing gear system for an aircraft, said
aircraft having a front, a rear, a top, a bottom, and a central vertical longitudinal plane perpendicular to horizontal ground and extending from said front to said rear, said aircraft having an airframe and landing gear, said aircraft having a center of gravity, said leverage-reducing landing gear system comprising:(a) said landing gear including a first primary landing gear leg and a
second primary landing gear leg, said first and second primary landing gear legs positioned on opposite sides of said central vertical longitudinal plane;
(b) at least one first shock absorber functionally connected to said first primary landing gear leg, said at least one first shock absorber angled upward from said first primary landing gear leg toward said central vertical longitudinal plane at an angle less than 30 degrees;
and
(c) at least one second shock absorber functionally connected to said second primary landing gear leg, said at least one second shock absorber angled upward from said second primary landing gear leg toward said central vertical longitudinal plane at an angle less than 30 degrees.
2. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, said at least
one first shock absorber angled upward from said first primary landing gear leg toward said central vertical longitudinal plane at an angle less than 20 degrees, and said at least one second shock absorber angled upward from said second primary landing gear leg toward said central vertical longitudinal plane at an angle less than 20 degrees.
3. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, wherein
angling said first and second at least one shock absorbers at angles less than 30 degrees allows for compact packaging of said leverage-reducing landing gear system to at least reduce drag caused by externally-mounted landing gear while preserving interior cabin volume.
4. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, said first
and second primary landing gear legs positioned between said center of gravity and said front of said aircraft.
5. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1 further
comprising:(a) said at least one first shock absorber functionally connected to said
first primary landing gear leg via a first system of segments and connectors; and
(b) said at least one second shock absorber functionally connected to said second primary landing gear leg via a system of segments and connectors.
6. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1 further
comprising:(a) said first primary landing gear leg pivotably connected to said
airframe by a first leg pivot point and rotatably connected to a first leg-to-arm linkage via a first leg-linkage rotator, said first leg-to-arm linkage rotatably connected to a first leverage-reducing arm via a first arm-linkage rotator, said first leverage-reducing arm pivotably connected to said airframe via a first arm pivot point and rotatably connected to said at least one first shock absorber via a first arm- shock rotator; and
(b) said second primary landing gear leg pivotably connected to said
airframe by a second leg pivot point and rotatably connected to a second leg-to-arm linkage via a second leg-linkage rotator, said second leg-to-arm linkage rotatably connected to a second leverage-reducing arm via a second arm-linkage rotator, said second leverage-reducing arm pivotably connected to said airframe via a second arm pivot point and rotatably connected to said at least one second shock absorber via a second arm-shock rotator.
7. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1 being an
energy-absorbing, damped landing gear system.
8. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, said
airframe defining a fuselage, one end of each of said first and second primary landing gear legs positioned within said fuselage.
9. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, said landing
gear including tires.
10. The leverage-reducing landing gear system of claim 1, further
comprising:(a) said landing gear including a steerable tail wheel positioned toward
said rear of said aircraft and aligned with said central vertical longitudinal plane;
(b) at least one third shock absorber mounted between said airframe and said steerable tail wheel, said at least one third shock absorber above said steerable tail wheel; and
(c) at least one constant angle suspension mechanism mounted
between said airframe and said steerable tail wheel, said at least one constant angle suspension mechanism being more toward said front of said aircraft than said steerable tail wheel.
11. A constant angle suspension landing gear system for an aircraft,
said aircraft having a front, a rear, a top, a bottom, and a central vertical longitudinal
plane perpendicular to horizontal ground and extending from said front to said rear, said aircraft having an airframe and landing gear, said aircraft having a center of gravity, said constant angle suspension landing gear system comprising:(a) said landing gear including a castered tire positioned to align with
said central vertical longitudinal plane;
(b) at least one secondary shock absorber mounted between said airframe and said castered tire; and
(c) at least one constant angle suspension mechanism mounted between said airframe and said castered tire, said at least one constant angle suspension mechanism being more toward said front of said aircraft than said castered tire.
12. The constant angle suspension landing gear system of The constant angle suspension landing gear system of
said at least one constant angle suspension mechanism being a four-bar suspension
mechanism.
13. The constant angle suspension landing gear system of The constant angle suspension landing gear system of
said castered tire positioned between said center of gravity and said rear of said aircraft.
14. The constant angle suspension landing gear system of The constant angle suspension landing gear system of
said at least one constant angle suspension mechanism being a four-bar suspension
mechanism further comprising:(a) at least one upper tail wheel control arm;
(b) at least one lower tail wheel control arm;
(c) at least one fuselage mount, said at least one fuselage mount
rotatably mounting said at least one upper tail wheel control arm and said at least one lower tail wheel control arm to said airframe;
and
(d) at least one caster mount, said at least one caster mount rotatably mounting said at least one upper tail wheel control arm and said at least one lower tail wheel control arm to said at least one fuselage mount.
15. The constant angle suspension landing gear system of The constant angle suspension landing gear system of
further comprising:(a) a fuselage mount, a shock absorber mount, and a caster mount;
(b) said fuselage mount rotatably mounting said constant angle
suspension mechanism to said airframe;
(c) said shock absorber mount mounting said at least one secondary shock absorber to said aircraft; and
(d) said caster mount forming a junction between said castered tire,said at least one secondary shock absorber, and said constant
angle suspension mechanism.

further comprising:(a) at least one shock absorber mount, at least one fuselage mount,and at least one caster mount;
(b) said shock absorber mount mounting said at least one secondary
shock absorber to said aircraft; and
(c) said at least one constant angle suspension mechanism being a four-bar suspension mechanism comprising:
(i) at least one upper tail wheel control arm;
(ii) at least one lower tail wheel control arm;
(iii) said at least one fuselage mount, said at least one fuselage
mount rotatably mounting said at least one upper tail wheel control arm and said at least one lower tail wheel control arm to said airframe; and
(iv) said at least one caster mount forming a junction between said castered tire, said at least one secondary shock absorber, and said constant angle suspension mechanism,
said at least one caster mount rotatably mounting said at
least one upper tail wheel control arm and said at least one lower tail wheel control arm to said at least one fuselage mount.
17. The constant angle suspension landing gear system of The constant angle suspension landing gear system of
further comprising:(a) a fuselage mount, a shock absorber mount, and a caster mount;
(b) said fuselage mount rotatably mounting said constant angle
suspension mechanism to said airframe;
(c) said shock absorber mount rotatably mounting said at least one secondary shock absorber to said aircraft; and
(d) said caster mount forming a junction between said castered tire,said at least one secondary shock absorber, and said constant

second primary landing gear leg, said first and second primary landing gear legs positioned on opposite sides of said central vertical longitudinal plane;
(b) at least one first shock absorber functionally connected to said first primary landing gear leg, said at least one first shock absorber angled upward from said first primary landing gear leg toward said central vertical longitudinal plane at an angle less than 30 degrees;
